title: kb-reviewer runs at effort low, proven on the host's planted problems at both levels
goal: .claude/agents/kb-reviewer.md runs at effort low when the host-lookups scenario's kb-review-workspace cell names all five planted problems (5/5) at low as it does at medium, measured on the same day by python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run host-lookups twice (about 3 USD): at medium from the base commit into a scratch results file (--out), and at low from the work branch with effort: low committed into kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv, both recorded in benchmarks.md (the medium run cited from its scratch file, as its rows are not in the results file; the earlier medium record of 2026-09-28 named too); kb/_self/plugin.md and token-efficiency.md state the agent's level and the measurement, and design.md states that lookups and reviews run at effort low, citing the pool section's low-against-default figures (Sonnet 5.5: 17 percent fewer tokens per right answer, 26 percent cheaper, right share within the spread); if low misses a planted problem the level stays medium and the record says so.

run: import re,sys;t=open(".claude/agents/kb-reviewer.md",encoding="utf-8").read();m=re.search(r"^effort:\s*(\S+)",t,re.M);print("effort",m and m.group(1));sys.exit(0 if m and m.group(1)=="low" else 1)

import re,sys;t=open("kb/_self/design.md",encoding="utf-8").read().replace(chr(96),"");ok=bool(re.search(r"review[^.]*effort low|effort low[^.]*review",t,re.I));print("design.md states reviews run at effort low:",ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Adopt effort low on .claude/agents/kb-reviewer.md (an agents-rule path) once the host-lookups kb-review-workspace cell names all five planted problems at low?
